BiblicalUsage: An imperious whorish woman is Ezekiel's charge against Jerusalem, a city whose heart was weak. She did all these things, says the Lord GOD, the work of an imperious whorish woman, hiring her lovers instead of being hired.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a weak heart shows itself in domineering sin, and Jerusalem's whoredom was proud even in its shame.
